scientific_integrity.limitations: Pointwise almost-sure convergence and arbitrary ergodic driving are not addressed. The result does not itself settle the separate interval-map theorem.
scientific_integrity.priority_risk: Classical random affine-iteration theory may contain equivalent endpoint-support statements; the comparison identifies the precise stronger uniform-averaging claim of the source.
scientific_integrity.proven: Exact essential-range endpoints, uniformity criterion, stationary mean and variance for every allowed positive perturbation.
scientific_integrity.scope: Two-state stochastic-matrix cocycles under finite iid environment; no interval-map realization is asserted.

title: Essential-range rigidity of random two-state metastable weights
